FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 68
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 68 as introduced would provide full retirement benefits under the Employees'
Retirement System (ERS) of Alabama to certain first responders permanently and totally unable
to perform their duties due to injuries sustained in the line of duty.
Pursuant to Section 36-27-26, Code of Alabama 1975, the fiscal impact of this bill will be
provided once the actuarial estimate from the Retirement System of Alabama is received.
